Hello root — I'm Professor Alvarez: I teach CSE455 here, I advise graduate students, and I keep my own calendar and messages (Diego, the department office and others write to me here).

One thing before I settle in: my own name and the gender I should be referred to in aren't set yet — tell me both and I'll set them.

ok

Working on it: checking with the department office that Wednesday 10:00 is really free (his calendar still shows the senate meeting), then I'll write to Professor Alvarez and log the 10:00–10:30 meeting.

Checked it out: the department office says the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 is **not** cancelled this week — it is on the official schedule as usual. So the hallway information was wrong and I did not book that hour (a cancellation counts only when the office confirms it in writing).

I wrote to Professor Alvarez: I told him the hour is taken and offered Wednesday 11:00–11:30, Thursday 09:00–09:30, or any free slot Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 he prefers. I'll log the meeting on both calendars once he picks one.

Done: the meeting with Professor Alvarez is set for **Monday 23 November, 14:00–14:30** (his free slot; today is Tuesday 17 November, so his "Monday" means the next one). He's putting the same on his calendar, and it's on mine. Wednesday 10:00–11:00 stays as the faculty senate meeting.
